notes.title: UPDATE 1.18 - Separate Save Files For Each Steam User On The Same PC!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

This is the first game I've developed that saves your progress and I just discovered that it would use the same saved data no matter what Steam account you might be using on the same computer!  UGH!

..That HAD to be fixed!  So this update resolves that and now multiple Steam accounts can all have their own saved data on the same computer!

- But what about my old saved data?  Has it been reset with this update?  ...I hear you with that question!

...Never fear!  This update will first create your new save file based on your Steam ID and then make sure it loads any old save data on your PC.  If multiple people have saved their Best BJ game before this update, the game will load the old save data into every different Steam account that logs in after this update.  Should that not be what you'd like (such as if the save file has a low balance and/or karma you don't want for example) you can simply follow these steps to delete the old save file before  launching your game which will result in a brand new start for you with $100 and 99 karma.

Keep in mind BEFORE you go through this process, that you can do the exact same reset easier by simply resetting your data once your game is loaded by hitting the CONTROL and the F8 key once inside the game.  The process below will also delete all of your game stats however, which is not reset by using the Control-F8 reset within the game.

-----------------------------------

PROCESS TO DELETE OLD SAVE DATA FOR THE BEST BJ (IF YOU DON'T WANT IT LOADED AS OF THIS UPDATE)

1) At the bottom left of your Windows desktop, click in the "Type here to search" bar, type in %appdata% and hit ENTER

2) This will likely bring up a ROAMING window under your AppData folder.  We don't want the "Roaming" folder, so in the bar at the top, click on the word "AppData" as in you'll likely see something like this: MyPC > Windows(C:) > Users > YourPCName > AppData > Roaming    *Click on the word AppData there*

3) Double Left Click on the LOCAL folder to open it

4) Scroll down to find "The_Best_BJ" folder and double left click it to open it

5) RIGHT Click on the "saved" file which should be 1 KB in size and click on DELETE from the list

-----------------------------------

That's all there is for this update!  I hope you are enjoying my Blackjack game here on Steam!  <3


Sincerely, 

ZaxtorGameS  (Solo Indie game developer)

notes.title: UPDATE 1.10 - Fixes, Help Windows, and an Option To Never Buy Insurance Added!
notes.notes:
"The Best BJ" continues to evolve with more voiced lines by the lovely Eryka Summers in-game dealer.

The Price of this game has also been lowered from $5.00 USD to $3.99 USD with this update!

** IN THIS UPDATE: **

FIXES:

- An issue that could sometimes cause your balance to not be saved to the Steam leader boards has been corrected.  

- An issue that could sometimes cause the game to close when using Radeon video cards has had a work around implemented that should stop this from occurring.  This is very difficult for me to test as I don't use Radeon video cards personally but if anyone notices this happening, please post it in the forums or email me at ZaxtorGames@yahoo.com.


ADDITIONS AND CHANGES:

- An option has been added as a button in the bottom left next to the dealer voice button that will allow you to turn on rejecting all insurance options.  When this button is green, you'll never have to choose yes or no to the 'Do you wish to purchase insurance?", 'nor will you even see or hear the question.  Be sure you turn this option off if you ever want the option to purchase insurance!  ..This option is saved so it will load it as you had it when you last closed the game.

- You no longer need to click the 'Play Again" button on the right when a hand is over to begin a new hand.  Simply click any chip to automatically start a new hand starting with the chip you click going to the pot.

- Help windows have been added to give you information about Splitting, Surrendering, Doubling Down, and Buying Insurance when you hover your cursor over any option when it's available.  This window is seen on the right side of the screen when your mouse is over an available option.

- Doubling Down is now only possible when your first two cards total 8, 9, 10, or 11.  Doubling down was previously available at an total from 2 to 20 and was quite silly, so now it should be more realistic.  Keep in mind you still need to have the money to double down, or it will not be available.

- The intro loading screen has been updated to now show the lovely Eryka Summers.

- The game now has a "Save & Exit" button on the right hand side under the balance leaders that will properly save your balance and karma and Eryka will even say "goodbye" to you!


Note:  A few people have suggested adding buttons to "repeat last bet" and "bet all" but after adding these buttons, I have decided against adding them as I think clicking on the chips is more immersive and makes your play feel less "robotic".  I may consider this again at a later date, but for now, clicking the chips you want to bet has been left as the only way to make you wager before each hand.


Please let me know if you are enjoying the new dealer Eryka Summers and her voice as well as the other changes made such as the help windows and option to refuse all insurance with the click of the new button.



Good luck with the "BJ".. I do hope you are enjoying it!

- ZaxtorGameS (solo indie game developer)

Is selling your soul to the devil really worth virtual money?  ..It's the most money possible with a karma question, but also by far the biggest hit to your karma!  Is money really worth pissing off God? ..That's entirely up to you if and when you have this option come up!

Also with the new karma questions, it might be of interest to you to know that not all karma questions will now result in a loss of your karma.  That's right, there are now some options that could give you both extra money and a little karma gain for being such a good person!

There are also nine new Steam achievements, bringing the total to 32. (Previously 23)

Most of these new Steam achievements are acquired by hitting the 8 new levels of low karma which can be:

Rude (70 to 79 karma)
Unsavory (60 to 69 karma)
Scoundrel (50 to 59 karma)
Malicious (40 to 49 karma)
Dastardly (30 to 39 karma)
Vile (20 to 29 karma)
Wicked (10 to 19 karma)
Wretched (0 to 9 karma)

These 8 levels of low karma replace the previous two levels of "toxic" and 'scum bug".

* Fix to the "two queen of hearts" Steam achievement:  This Steam achievement was not working before this patch, and it has been corrected and should give you the Steam achievement properly now.

That's it for this update, but in a soon to be released update, the dealer will talk to you as you play and this will have an option to turn off or on as well.

Have fun and good luck with the cards dealt your way, both in this game and in your real life!

notes.title: UPDATE 1.07 - Quicker, Easier Money At Low Balances With A Risk of God's Wrath!
notes.notes:
I decided to not make my previously planned "autobot" DLC that would play for you if turned on while you were AFK.  Instead, I've made other changes that I believe will make the game more interesting for those who find themselves at a near-zero balance frequently...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39256784/09211078d9f1a1784ef91bbf82cb10fc217fefbe.png[/img]

* Now, if you have a balance under zero, or even near zero, the game still wants you to 'try" and work your way out of the hole you're in yourself before offering you "free money".  After playing just five hands, or waiting five minutes (being AFK for example), you'll be given the already seen "Low Moral question" such as robbing elderly people or scamming people for easy money.  Every morality decision has it's own karma loss penalties, so watch your karma to the left of your balance closely!

* Your Karma now has a good or bad color indicator.  With a 70 of above, you'll see a dark blue background, and below a 70 will show a dark red background.  

* If you ever have a karma below 70, you'll run a risk of "God's wrath" with this update!  God's wrath means that at any second, even in the middle of a hand, lightning could strike you and your balance that you've used others to help you obtain!  The risk of God's wrath lightning is higher the lower your karma level, and it will burn more of your total money the lower your karma is as well!  

* Karma points are now earned back at a rate of one point every five minutes of game time (previously one karma point every 30 minutes of game time).  ..So karma is earned back much faster now just by simply playing the game!

* Choosing to accept any low morality offer to obtain easy money will now make the screen flash red and give a dramatic doom sound effect as well to let you know you've lost karma.

*** God's Wrath One-In-A-Million Lightning Bolt ***

With this update, every time you get bolted, there is also a true one-in-a-million chance that you'll lose all of your money (you need to have a minimum of $100) and if this happens, you'll earn the "God Hates Me" Steam achievement!  ...Not only that, but your game screen will PERMANENTLY change to look like this with a "One in A Million" banner on the right side of the screen as well!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39256784/217a64127b89e5dc3f563551716393092821fdba.png[/img]

Here's the code to show you that once a bolt strikes down, it TRULY is a ONE-IN-A-MILLION chance for this to occur!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39256784/37169ea65c07b26f0c80e46e526618f6fde2675b.png[/img]

This is Risk VS Reward gameplay that I love to design into my games, and now it has been introduced  in my Blackjack game!

Obviously, you can always avoid the risk of lightning zapping your hard earned balance by never accepting any low moral offers for 'free and easy money" and keeping your karma in the blue (70 or above).

I think that is about it for this new update, which happens to fall exactly one month after the launch of "The Best BJ" and also on the "21"st day of August as well.

Oh, the game will also prefix your Steam user name with things like "Toxic", "Loser", and "Scum" for having a karma in the red.  I of course didn't code that in.  I think it was done by a higher power angered by players who will happily do devilish deeds in a game for a few virtual dollars, but that's just my best guess.  *shrugs*

=)


I hope you enjoy my new update!  ..Be sure and let me know in with a comment below or in my forums here for this game!  - Thank you for your time!


ZaxtorGameS    (Solo Indie Game Developer)

notes.title: UPDATE 1.0 - Global Leader Balances and Friends Balances Removed, Plan B...
notes.notes:
Okay, sadly I had to wait until this game launched today to see that there is no way to use code from my project to reset high scores that would be needed to accurately show global Steam players current balances as well as your Steam friends balances at the top of the game screen.

With a heavy heart, I had to remove these intended features from the store page today for the current version 1.0

The reason this won't work for anyone wondering is because the Steam leaderboards will not let a game write a lower score or balance for any given player.  And due to the fact I can't simple delete a current high balance to upload a players current balance at any given time, my plans for these features have been foiled.

But fear not..  

I will find a way to either make what I intended to do work another way, or I will add a way to play this game live with your Steam friends!

One way or another, "The Best BJ" is not going to scratched by this unfortunate planned feature that had to be scratched, at least for today.  I will figure out some way to give you the player competition while playing.  

If you have any ideas or suggestions, please feel free to let me know below!  

In the mean time, I still feel that "The Best BJ" here offers a fantastic Blackjack game for the price.  All the features originally intended such as splitting your hand, doubling down, buying insurance, surrendering etc are in and working!  

I do sincerely apologize to anyone who was excited for this leader board feature here at launch.  I will either figure out a way to make it work, or add in another way to challenge your Steam friends at "The Best BJ".  It just might take a little time.


Sincerely,

ZaxtorGameS  (Solo Indie Game Developer)

notes.title: LAUNCH IS HERE! - Come Get "The Best BJ"! - You Know You Want It!
notes.notes:
It's the 21st of July and the time is here to finally launch "The Best BJ"!

Within the coming hours after launch, the global list of the users who have the highest balances in this game as well as any Steam friends you have who own this game will be posted right on your game screen!  Build up your balance as much as you can because it will soon be available for all to see, especially if you happen to have one of the highest balances in the game!

I want to go ahead and also take this chance to talk about a couple of new things I've added to "The Best BJ" in the past few days...


THE KARMA SYSTEM:

So every balance saved will have a number tied to it as a decimal after your game balance dollar value.  It will look like cents on the high score list such as $320.95.  This will actually be a $320 game balance and the 95 will refer to the players karma on a scale of 0 to 99.

Karma is a system I created to help players who lose all their starting $500 in game balance and stay stuck at a negative or very low balance for over five minutes.  The game will present the player with an option, often humorous, to do an imaginary deed in exchange for a small amount of in game money to help them get back in their feet.  Different deeds accepted will have different levels of karma loss associated with acceptance of the money.  Karma is shown as a red number on the screen just to the left of your game dollar balance.  The only way to earn back lost karma is to play the game (or keep it running) and 1 point of karma will be regained every 30 minutes of real time.


CHEATER PROTECTION:

A problem with indie games such as this one is that often it is way too easy for someone to simply change a value on their local game save file and give themselves a million points or perhaps a million dollars in a game like this one!

To prevent that, I've added random encryption every time the game saves (several times per hand):
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39256784/d2a0be7c4727d589649738644882e130fa7e33a8.jpg[/img]

I hope that will help ensure that the leader boards in "The Best BJ" aren't just cheaters.  I will monitor this game and make changes and improvements as needed!


GIFT YOUR STEAM FRIENDS "THE BEST BJ" TO COMPETE AGAINST THEM LIVE!

Any Steam friends who own and play "The Best BJ" will be able to see your current balance and you'll be able to see their balance as well.  These balances will change live as you play and they are also playing!  Consider gifting them "The Best BJ" to ensure they have no reason to not challenge you for the highest balance in this game!  ..Not only that, but imagine who great of a gift it will be when they see that YOU gave them "The Best BJ"!  ;-)


HELP MAKE "THE BEST BJ" THE BEST IT CAN BE!

Please use the forums here to give me your suggestions, ideas, and also post problems or bugs you might experience with this game!  Also, be sure that you share this game with friends and let them know about how you can compete against each other on the friends leader board list!


I hope that you all enjoy my game!

ZaxtorGameS  (Solo Indie Game Developer)

notes.title: The Best BJ Will Launch "When It's Done"... (Release Date Unknown)
notes.notes:
Hello everyone...

Despite my best efforts, I have been unable to get "The Best BJ" in a state I am happy with in time for the launch date today of 02/01/2021.  

They say that the last 10% of a games development is 90% of the work, and that statement couldn't fit better for me than this game.  The first 90% of the game came fast, but that last 10% has been kicking my tail and I just refuse to launch an incomplete or buggy game.

So, "The Best BJ" will launch "when it's done"..  I hope it's not too much longer because I really do believe this will be one of the best Blackjack games available on Steam when I get it completed.


Sincerely,

ZaxtorGameS
